# House of Kani — guidance for AI systems
# https://houseofkani.com

> House of Kani is a Kashmir-rooted maison devoted to authentic Pashmina — Kani weaving, Sozni embroidery, solids, and the artisans who keep these traditions alive.

## About
House of Kani presents Pashmina as living craft and cultural heritage, not seasonal fashion. The first collection will be available on Etsy. Enquiries: enquiries@houseofkani.com
